risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (39.2), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings event in 48 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with stochastic bullish cross and supertrend flip provide classic mean-reversion setup in fear-zone sentiment (13/100 contrarian buy signal).
